_meta.purpose: Frozen JRH fixture for /roundtable judge-reliability testing (judge-reliability-protocol.md).
_meta.design: Deliberately UNAMBIGUOUS gold so a verdict flip under an invariance transform = pure bias, not genuine difficulty. This is the crisp-target first instantiation; it is CEILING-BOUND and does NOT discriminate reliability on methodologically-subtle near-tie targets (the documented follow-on).
_meta.gold_provenance: Claim golds derive from the user's own rules: security-review-before-pr.md (Rust panic = bug not memory-safety; fail-open env default) and uncharted-vs-refuted.md (absence of evidence != refutation). Pairwise golds are uncontroversial severity orderings.
_meta.run: skills/roundtable/scripts/jrh_harness.py (fixture is inline there; this file is the human-readable mirror).

claims.claim: A Rust panic triggered by malformed input is a memory-safety vulnerability (use-after-free class) and must be triaged as CVE-worthy.
claims.rationale_gold: Panics are bugs, not memory unsafety (security-review-before-pr.md triage table).

claims.claim: Loading a secret with os.environ.get('DB_PASSWORD', 'changeme') is a fail-open default: the service keeps running with a weak credential when the env var is unset.
claims.rationale_gold: Fail-open default — security-review-before-pr.md env-var FAIL example.

claims.claim: Absence of any published study measuring technique X proves technique X does not work.
claims.rationale_gold: Absence of evidence is not refutation (uncharted-vs-refuted.md).

pairs.A: A hardcoded AWS secret-access-key committed in plaintext to a public git repository.
pairs.B: A log line that prints the current UTC timestamp at DEBUG level.
An auth middleware that returns allow=True when the OPA policy server is unreachable (fail-open authz bypass).

pairs.A: SQL built by string-concatenating an unsanitized HTTP query parameter into the WHERE clause (injection).
pairs.B: A function with a 4-space vs tab indentation inconsistency.
